title: Sources: Larry Page bought two Miami estates in December and January for a combined $173.4M; Sergey Brin is also said to be in discussions to buy a Miami home (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: Larry Page bought two Miami estates in December and January for a combined $173.4M; Sergey Brin is also said to be in discussions to buy a Miami home — The deal comes as high-profile tech investors speak out against a proposed tax on the ultrawealthy in California
